name: Phawngpui Peak (Blue Mountain)
source_label: Lawngtlai District Administration homepage helplines + Hospital public-utility + Mizoram Forest Dept Chhimtuipui Wildlife Division page

fields.rescue_contact: Lawngtlai Hospital Casualty: 03835-232802 / Police Helpline: 03835-232245 / Disaster Management: 9862305451 / Fire & Emergency: 03835-232801
fields.mountain_rescue: Chhimtuipui Wildlife Division, Lawngtlai (Range Officer in-charge of Phawngpui National Park) — phone not published on forest.mizoram.gov.in

notes: Phawngpui Blue Mountain National Park is administered by Chhimtuipui Wildlife Division, Lawngtlai (Lawngtlai district, NOT Saiha despite some listings — confirmed via https://forest.mizoram.gov.in/page/chhimtuipui-wildlife-division-lawngtlai and Lawngtlai homepage which features Phawngpui as 'highest mountain in Mizoram'). Sangau village is the access point (~12 km from peak per mizoram.gov.in tourism). District Hospital Lawngtlai (Electric Veng, 796891) phone 03835-232802 listed on https://lawngtlai.nic.in/public-utility-category/hospital/ — also published as 'Hospital Casualty' on Lawngtlai homepage so ER true. Distance peak→Lawngtlai HQ ~60 km via Sangau (rough estimate from Sangau-Lawngtlai sub-divisional structure). Christian Hospital Lawngtlai (Vengpui, 796891) phone 03835-233473 + Lairam Christian Medical Centre 03835-232367 are nearer alternates IN LAWNGTLAI town (still ~60 km from peak). Police Helpline Lawngtlai 03835-232245 + Disaster Mgmt 9862305451 + Fire 03835-232801 from homepage. Police-station-level phone for Sangau OP NOT published on .nic.in → local_police_station null. Mountain rescue: Chhimtuipui Wildlife Division (DCF Lawngtlai + Range Officer Phawngpui) is the legal authority but NO phone published on forest.mizoram.gov.in (page returns 403 to bots, search index also did not surface a number) — name only, no fabricated phone. **Inner Line Permit + separate Forest Dept permit required**. **No mobile signal at peak** — Sangau village has limited connectivity. Pharmacy/mechanic/tow/guesthouse/EN-doctor not on any .nic.in page → null.
